---
title: "06 · Memory and durable state"
---

Which information should survive a call, a restart, or a user session?

## Concepts

Separate temporary working context, a run's authoritative checkpoint, and records for later retrieval. Give each a writer, a version, and a retention rule. Consider feedback stored as episodic memory [@shinn2023reflexion].

## Study task

Define a checkpoint after the second AutoResearch trial. Decide which fields are required to resume without rescoring or accepting a stale candidate.

## Deliverable

Submit the checkpoint schema and a before-and-after example covering a restart and a schema change.
